en.Eine kleine Karte mit echter Spielleiste:
A small map with the real game bar - without starting the game. It draws the delivered BC7 pixels with the Unity pivots on the 64x32 tile grid, 1:1 with point filtering and the GPU raster rule (measured against the tester screenshot of 4 Sep 2026: 95-97 % pixel agreement, the rest is grass blades of neighbouring tiles). Your own changes can be sent through the same BC7 compression.
Approximated: team colour (red channel of the mask), wind (frame sequence); lighting/fog are missing. The bar comes from real screenshots; edited UI crops are only inserted where they are found reliably (NCC >= 0.9).
